craft_notes: Sthāyin: vismaya at sundered-varied shine — stain and shine in one breath throughout. Outcast-purity dived in I-ness; both-way kept. Rejected: (a) outcast→outer → killed: outcast carries exile. Read aloud: OF-both … PUR-i-ty OF-out-CAST-things — IN-I-ness — IM-mer-SION.

lines: Of both — there indeed the way: pure, impure, self — by difference —
purity of outcast things — in I-ness — immersion.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ubhayo tatra vai rītiḥ śuddhāśuddhātmabhedataḥ | śuddhir bahiṣkṛtārthānāṃ svāhantāyāṃ nimajjanam
